answer: Farming becomes an atlas bet on surviving 93 epochs of grading, and every ripple settlement recomputes the thread schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 93 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
